CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the main configuration file for watcher-decision-engine.

PYARGV.description: Additional Python arguments passed to the daemon.

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group to run the daemon as.

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user to run the daemon as.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the configuration file containing bind settings.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the IP address in the bind config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the port in the bind config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section name in the bind config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the number of workers in the bind config file.

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to the UWSGI application ini file.

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to the UWSGI configuration file.

UWSGI_PORT.description: Port for the UWSGI HTTP/HTTPS socket. If empty, it is derived from the bind config file.
